package gin

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestZZProbe(t *testing.T) {
	// fresh, no reset
	f := &responseWriter{}
	t.Logf("fresh: status=%d size=%d written=%v", f.Status(), f.Size(), f.Written())

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	w := &responseWriter{}
	w.reset(rec)
	t.Logf("reset: status=%d size=%d written=%v", w.Status(), w.Size(), w.Written())
	w.WriteHeader(404)
	t.Logf("after WH(404): status=%d size=%d written=%v recCode=%d", w.Status(), w.Size(), w.Written(), rec.Code)
	w.WriteHeaderNow()
	t.Logf("after WHN: status=%d size=%d written=%v recCode=%d", w.Status(), w.Size(), w.Written(), rec.Code)
	w.WriteHeader(500)
	t.Logf("after WH(500): status=%d size=%d written=%v recCode=%d", w.Status(), w.Size(), w.Written(), rec.Code)
	n, err := w.WriteString("xy")
	t.Logf("WriteString: n=%d err=%v size=%d status=%d recCode=%d", n, err, w.Size(), w.Status(), rec.Code)
	w.WriteHeader(0)
	w.WriteHeader(-1)
	t.Logf("after WH(0),WH(-1): status=%d", w.Status())
}
EOF
go test -run TestZZProbe -v . 2>&1 | head -20; rm zz_probe_test.go
